free_tier: free public web pages; no key, no registration
rate_limits: no published limit; this project used <= 8 requests per run at >= 0.9 s interval
licence: public domain: FDA website content is not copyrighted unless otherwise noted (FDA Website Policies)
update_frequency: on change (each alert has a Publish Date; the by-publish-date index re-sorts accordingly)
historical_coverage: current list only (154 alerts at probe time); superseded alert revisions and removed firms are not archived in the index
known_limitations: No openFDA or JSON endpoint exists for import alerts; the public data is server-rendered HTML at accessdata.fda.gov/cms_ia/.
The bare directory https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cms_ia/ returns HTTP 403.14 (directory listing forbidden); concrete .html pages are required (verified live).

The index table has four columns (number, type, publish date, name) and NO company column. Firm names exist only inside each alert's 'Red List', which is div-based markup, not a table, and can be several megabytes per alert.

An import alert is an enforcement instruction about foreign establishments/product types, not a company quality rating; red-listing and de-listing are administrative events, and absence from the current list carries no information.

Because firm-level enumeration needs one multi-MB fetch per alert and there are 154 alerts, a complete firm-level census is out of budget; this project reports firm-level coverage as UNKNOWN rather than extrapolating from a sample.
Publish Date is the alert publication/revision date, not the date of the underlying violation; event_at is unknown and left null.
research_value: Adds a cross-border manufacturing-risk lane: import alerts name foreign establishments whose devices are detained without physical examination. For a device-supply chain radar this is an independent, regulator-authored signal of offshore production problems that does not appear in recalls or clearances, and MedRadar can check whether any alert targets a target firm's foreign plants.
cost_notes: free; index page ~66 KB, device group page ~27 KB, detail pages can be 40 KB to 5 MB each; no bulk export
